deployment_config.architecture: same-origin: this engine serves the Next.js static export AND /api/* on $PORT (no proxy, no CORS, no client-side keys)
deployment_config.authority: ENGINE_COMMIT + PORTFOLIO_COMMIT + this deployment configuration = the reproducible deployed product

pins.portfolio_release: R387-3D-QUALITY-EDITION (ENGINE_RELEASE_REGISTRY.json entry; CANONICAL_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json pins 924 buyer-surface files)
pins.portfolio_acquisition: toscanini/start.sh fetches EXACTLY this sha at container start (git fetch --depth 1 <sha>; token-safe GIT_ASKPASS). A moving branch NEVER determines buyer-package contents.
pins.engine_commit: IDENTITY = BUILD ARTIFACT ONLY (R396 A.3-A.6). The Docker build bakes ARTIFACT_IDENTITY.json + ARTIFACT_IDENTITY.sha256 from RENDER_GIT_COMMIT (build-arg) or git rev-parse HEAD; /api/health reports the artifact-derived SHA with a runtime tamper check (BUILD_ARTIFACT_SHA == RUNNING_ARTIFACT_SHA == HEALTH_REPORTED_SHA). The ENGINE_COMMIT env var, if set, is an operator-declared EXPECTATION cross-checked for drift — it NEVER defines identity.

secrets: GITHUB_TOKEN (private-repo acquisition + runtime-state pushes; supplied via GIT_ASKPASS, never in URLs/argv/image/logs)

ENGINE_OPERATOR_KEY (R396 A.2 / R394 s15: operator visibility capability for /api/sessions; set on the service, verified present via health.operator_key_configured, the value itself is never disclosed)

transport.note: explicit operator overrides (R375 mechanism) — recorded in every call-site ledger and in candidate provenance; NVIDIA_MODEL is the registry's existing per-provider model override. Measured 2026-09-02 from the deployment source network: 3 consecutive OK completions, 1.5-3.1 s, FIELD-line compliant.

persistence.note: minimum durable layer: session/job metadata, evidence references, key run artifacts, package zips — committed to the private engine repo's runtime-state branch via the existing GITHUB_TOKEN. Large regenerable intermediates stay ephemeral.

deploy_procedure: 1. Repo clean and pushed; CI green on the exact commit (Art. XXIII/XXVI).
2. autoDeploy OFF on the Render service — a moving main never silently redeploys.
3. Verify service env: GITHUB_TOKEN, NVIDIA_API_KEY, NVIDIA_MODEL=openai/gpt-oss-120b, ENGINE_*_PROVIDER=nvidia pins, DURABLE_STATE_ENABLED=1, ENGINE_OPERATOR_KEY set (R396 A.2).
4. Trigger the deploy pinned to the exact commit (Render deploy API, commit id). The Dockerfile bakes the artifact identity from RENDER_GIT_COMMIT/git at build time.

5. Verify: GET /api/health -> deployment_identity.deployment_drift=GREEN, engine_commit == the deployed sha (artifact-derived, source build_artifact), identity_tamper=false, portfolio_pin_match=true, llm_transport_ready=true (real live completion), discovery_ready=true, durable.last_snapshot.ok=true (boot snapshot, R396 B.2).
6. Run a FRESH discovery through the public URL (never a replayed fixture).
7. Run the R396 external acceptance probes P1-P7 (scripts/r396_external_probes.py) against the public host and preserve the raw outputs (Phase C).

security.secrets_scope: server-side only; adversarial leak scan (scripts/r392_readiness_tests.py) covers HTML, JS bundle, API responses, logs, and the Docker build context

pins_env.ENGINE_COMMIT: OPTIONAL expectation pin only (R396 A.3) — cross-checked against the artifact identity; never the identity source

r396_release_gate.deployment: deployment_identity.deployment_drift == GREEN with identity_tamper == false and health_reported_commit == the deployed git sha (BUILD == RUNNING == HEALTH)
r396_release_gate.durability: durable.last_snapshot.ok == true (the boot snapshot after restore; a restore without a successful preceding snapshot is not durability evidence)
r396_release_gate.probes: P1-P7 raw outputs preserved in the worklog; CI results are NOT external acceptance
